relationships.subject: garlic organosulfur compounds
relationships.evidence_quote: These bioactives regulate key signaling pathways such as NF-κB, Nrf2/HO-1, PI3K/Akt, and JNK, while also modulating TRPV1 and TRPA1 ion channels involved in nociception and central sensitization

key_findings: Review: garlic organosulfur compounds (allicin, SAC, DADS, DATS) show antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, anti-apoptotic and mitochondrial-stabilizing effects relevant to neuropathic pain.
Evidence is mostly preclinical; clinical data and standardized preparations are lacking.
